verdict.rationale: Background automations are a fair question for a transcription service, but the evidence shows no user-configurable automation, trigger, or recurring workflow feature in Scribe. The only related item is async processing of a single API request with results delivered to webhooks (docs-14). That is a one-off asynchronous action, not an autonomous, recurring automation, so it earns no credit. The MCP server and SDKs are developer building blocks rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
